purpose: Complete the descriptive 2x2 source-by-objective interpretation at every fixed lambda, without choosing settings from tests.
interaction_formula: (B4-B3)-(B2-B1), paired within the same seed and lambda
summaries: All individual values, mean and sample SD across exactly3 pipeline seeds; no new p-values, significance, equivalence test, or bootstrap.
interpretation: An additive source/objective response would have zero interaction contrast at that setting; nonzero observed contrast alone is not proof of a specific causal mechanism. Positive G is better; negative F is better. Across-lambda points share seeds/data and are not independent replicates.
